extracted.intended_audience: journalists, conference attendees, law enforcement and public security agencies
extracted.subtask_description: A short press release announcing an organization's presence and demonstrations at a trade show/conference, summarizing technologies, dates, location, theme, and links for more information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Headline and subhead
rubrics_metrics.description: Fraunhofer at GPEC 2026 / Technologies for Identifying Deepfakes, Cyberattacks and Drone Threats
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear main headline stating the organization and event, and a concise subhead that highlights the primary topics or technologies being announced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release type and date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prominently display that the item is a press release and include the publication/release date near the top so readers and editors can immediately assess timeliness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead paragraph summarizing the announcement
rubrics_metrics.description: Artificial intelligence, advanced sensor technologies and immersive simulation are opening new possibilities for law enforcement and public security agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open with a short paragraph that states the core news or claim and situates it (technologies, trends, or opportunities), giving readers a quick summary of why the announcement matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event details (what, when, where)
rubrics_metrics.description: From May 20 to 22, 2026, the Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft will present new internal security solutions at the GPEC General Police Equipment Exhibitions & Conference in Leipzig.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include explicit event name, dates, and location so readers know when and where the demonstrations or appearances will occur.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific location/booth information
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide exact booth or stand location within the venue to allow visitors and press to find the exhibitor easily.

rubrics_metrics.name: Theme or tagline
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the theme “Internal Security Made by Fraunhofer—Forensics · Surveillance · Training,”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the event theme or tagline that frames the demonstrations and messaging; use the quoted theme/tagline verbatim if provided to maintain branding consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participating units or contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: four Fraunhofer institutes will demonstrate how their developments can be applied in practice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Name or indicate which internal units, institutes, or partners are involved in the activity to establish credibility and attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technologies and applications described
rubrics_metrics.description: technologies for analyzing digital evidence, identifying threats at an early stage and training personnel in realistic environments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List the key technologies and the practical problems or applications they address so readers understand capabilities and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benefit / practical application statement
rubrics_metrics.description: how their developments can be applied in practice
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain the practical benefits or intended users (e.g., law enforcement, public security) to connect the announcement to real-world impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call to action / further information link
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a clear call to action and link or pointer to more detailed information (event page, press kit, contact) so interested parties can follow up.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branding and copyright credit
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display organizational branding and any copyright or ownership notices to protect content and signal official source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Placement within press/newsroom section
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place the announcement under a clearly labeled press or newsroom section so media and stakeholders can find official communications.
